interface.title: LabChronicle | Database Visualizer
interface.field: Wet-lab biology / lab data and inventory management (cell biology, molecular biology)
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment planning, inventory management, and reporting (materials and methods, lab meetings)
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit browser for a lab's YAML database in a GitHub repository: pick a category (antibodies, cell lines, animal models, plasmids, dyes, small molecules, siRNAs, experiments, publications), filter and search the table, open a full detail card for any record, and export the selected rows as CSV or PDF.

data.note: Loaded with 'Load bundled example database' (Option 1); the banner then reads 'Loaded: app'. Each category holds only 1–2 records, for example 2 antibodies (Anti-Vimentin D21H3 and Anti-Vimentin Chicken, which has no catalog ID, an Empty tube and Reorder = Yes), 2 cell lines (HeLa-WT with STR profiling; HeLa-LifeAct-GFP with no authentication or DOI), 2 experiments (EXP001, EXP002), 2 plasmids (pCMV-Empty-Vector not sequence-validated, low stock), 2 siRNAs (siPAK1-2 Empty, needs reorder), 1 dye, 1 small molecule and 1 publication. I tried Option 2 (GitHub URL) only far enough to see its validation message.

features.name: Category switcher with per-schema sidebar filters
features.general: Choose a record type and get a filter panel built from that type's fields: free-text boxes for text fields, multi-select lists for categorical fields, and range sliders for dates, all combined with AND; storage-location codes are shown as readable box names
features.specific: The 'Database options' selectbox swaps among Animal Models, Antibodies, Cell Lines, Dyes, Experiments, Plasmids, Publications, Small Molecules and siRNAs. Sidebar 'Filter Options' rebuilds itself, for example Antibodies get Location / Clonality / Reorder? multiselects and a Last Time Checked slider, and siRNAs get a Date slider. Box_IDs in location fields are translated to readable box names from lab_database/boxes (app.py:419-456, 971-978), e.g. '-20C Box 1' in the Plasmids Location multiselect
steps: choose a category in Database options
open Filter Options in the sidebar
type in a text filter (case-sensitive substring) or pick values in a multiselect
drag a date range slider handle
read 'Showing N records' and the filtered table
remove a chip (×) to relax the filter
serves_tasks: List the reagents against a given target and narrow them by application
Find experiments by the instrument used
Filter items by storage location
List items flagged for reorder
Restrict items to a date range

features.name: Auto-generated experiment narrative
features.general: Turn a structured experiment record into a readable paragraph naming who did it, when, the method, materials, conditions and where the raw data is stored, with links to the metadata files
features.specific: In Experiments, the detail card opens with 'Short description' (operator, start date, primary method, cell lines, animal models, conditions, hard drive LaCie-HD001, folder, 'here' links to metadata.yaml and drive_metadata.yaml). The same text is the 'Experiment Description' column in Mobile view and in the CSV export

open the detail card for an experiment
read the Short description and the conditions list
turn on Mobile view to get the description as a column
export the rows to CSV

features.general: Tick rows in a data grid (one at a time, all visible, or cleared), see a running count, and download just those rows as CSV or as a PDF table
features.specific: Select column checkboxes plus 'Select all rows' and 'Clear selection'. 'Selected rows: N' enables the CSV and PDF buttons, which download selected_rows.csv (with a Source YAML File column) and selected_rows.pdf (ReportLab). The selection survives filtering

The data-grid toolbar (Show/hide columns, Download as CSV, Search, Fullscreen): it is listed in the accessibility tree but never appeared on hover, and clicking it by ref timed out
The pages behind the experiment 'here' links: they point to repo-relative #/blob/main/... paths that only resolve once a GitHub repo is loaded
The Animal Models detail card: I saw only the table (screens/007.webp)
not_done: Antibody dilution and validation per application are never shown, because of an app bug rather than a missing schema field: the config defines 'Immunofluorescence/Western Blot/... Dilutions' and '... Validated' columns (app.py:170-179, 360-369) and the seeded vimentin.yaml holds them, but flatten_antibody (app.py:648) never flattens the nested 'dilutions' and 'validation' dicts into those keys, so app.py:990 drops them. They are absent from the table, the detail card (screens/014.webp) and the CSV. Stock (Tube's status, Reorder?) can be checked; Notes is free text, not a validation record

PDF export with all columns in Experiments fails: Select all rows in full view triggers a reportlab LayoutError traceback ('tallest cell 646.0 points, too large', df_to_pdf, app.py line 1164) and no export buttons are offered (screens/039.webp, screens/040.webp); Clear selection recovers (screens/042.webp). It works only in Mobile view

If the last-selected record is hidden by a filter, the detail section raises 'ValueError: 1 is not in list' (screens/058.webp); the replay hit the same fault as 'ValueError: 0 is not in list' (app.py line 1214) after the 'novus' global search. Clear selection recovers

UI lag one rerun behind: after a category switch the Global search box keeps showing old text that is not applied, then applies it on a later rerun (screens/027.webp vs 047.jpg). Sidebar text filters are case-sensitive ('vim' gives 0, 'Vim' gives 2); Global search is not
